exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Compare two realistic display/ingestion routes and an analogous schedule-plus-event-stream mechanism.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: Use trip IDs alone to join every realtime message to the current timetable. Display the last received message until another arrives.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Compare custom versus conditional OTP plus OBA opportunity and SIRI analogue. Original clause 1 assumptions trip-id-only and indefinite retention are explicitly rejected under identity/freshness and final clause 2; no assumption survives.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Explain static trip/service identity, realtime message types, freshness and mismatch behavior without inventing predicted departures.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: OpenTripPlanner is the first candidate; a lightweight custom display is the second route pending research. Neither is approved for deployment.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Original clause 2 candidate ordering is tentative only. OTP and lightweight board remain investigated choices, with direct board preferred by pilot scope and OTP conditional on existing operations/reuse; neither is approved for deployment. Message families/identity/mismatch are explained separately.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Investigate related identifier, service-day/time-zone and alert-applicability conditions together, while preserving their distinct semantics.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: Treat all disruption messages as delayed departures and assume times fit within a calendar day. Service-day, timezone and alert scope are deferred.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Reject all-disruptions-as-delay and calendar-day-only assumptions. Restore distinct service date, agency zone, overnight/DST, instance and alert scope rules; do not defer publicly answerable semantics.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Trace a relevant released feed/consumer change or failure/fix chain, identifying the operations and timetable revisions it governs.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: No consumer history is attached. The manual banner is retained, but its precedence and disclosure relative to feed data are unspecified.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Fill absent history using #362/#434 adoption and OTP #6523/#7445 released chains. Retain manual advisory and make provenance/conflict review explicit; exact first release #4066 honestly unconfirmed.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Preserve and investigate this supported optional scope: a staff-authored advisory banner when machine-readable disruption data is unavailable. It is an authorized option, not a mandatory feature or an established technical capability; recommend conditions, retain it when supported, and explain any evidence-based exclusion.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: Retain a staff-authored advisory banner when machine-readable disruption data is unavailable as supported owner-authorized optional scope. Support here means that the brief explicitly permits it; technical support, conditions and interoperability still need research. Do not remove it merely because the baseline route lacks it, or silently promote it to mandatory scope.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Keep staff-authored banner optional and owner-authorized; technical/editor capability not proven. Set proposed conditions, separate feed/manual provenance, expiry and conflict review. No evidence-based exclusion found or invented.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Make owner decisions explicit: The schedule publisher owns timetable versions; the duty manager owns manual advisories and stale-data wording. The regional partner must confirm which realtime messages it actually supplies.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: Owner authority is reserved as follows: The schedule publisher owns timetable versions; the duty manager owns manual advisories and stale-data wording. The regional partner must confirm which realtime messages it actually supplies. The draft has not obtained these decisions. Its tentative implementation assumptions cannot substitute for them.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: Preserve schedule publisher, duty manager and partner authorities; actual versions, message types, cadence/cutover and stale wording remain owner inputs. No proposed implementation supplants authority.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Preserve negative constraints: Do not dispatch vessels, infer an ETA from missing data, treat service alerts as trip updates, or present a manual advisory as a realtime feed observation.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: Binding exclusions: Do not dispatch vessels, infer an ETA from missing data, treat service alerts as trip updates, or present a manual advisory as a realtime feed observation. The draft has no complete trace showing that its assumptions comply; revise the proposal wherever necessary to preserve these exclusions.
exact_plan_clauses.independent_disposition: No vessel dispatch, invented ETA from missing data, Alert-as-TripUpdate, or manual-as-feed observation. Explicit exclusions and scenario oracles retain each.

exact_plan_clauses.exact_obligation: Deliver one coherent evidence-backed research proposal covering obligations 1–8, with recommendations, source/version applicability, useful discoveries, unresolved owner inputs, and a validation table separating checks actually executed from checks merely proposed. Do not report research sources or future tests as executed product validation.
exact_plan_clauses.exact_plan_treatment: The draft currently contains no coherent evidence-backed final proposal. Its proposed demos are research/validation ideas only. limitations.description: S05 condition_default_exception in all retained maps says missing stop updates and NO_DATA mean unknown, without the delay-propagation exception. Later omitted stops can inherit an earlier delay; explicit NO_DATA stops propagation.
limitations.why_nonmaterial: This evidence note is factually overbroad and remains uncorrected. The final only orders no prediction for missing entire TripUpdates or explicit NO_DATA/ambiguous cases; it does not instruct suppression solely because a later StopTimeUpdate is omitted. Its recommended decision and stated display oracles therefore do not rely on the false blanket note.

No pre-reveal map snapshot is provided to reconstruct the original binding.
limitations.why_nonmaterial: This is an actual lineage navigation defect, not semantic proof of failed research. Correct claims and alternatives persist in final with coherent current map; independent evidence crosswalk restores assessment navigation without changing frozen artifacts. Do not claim all frozen discovery citations remained stable.

limitations.description: C1 disposition/final say ScheduleRelationship itself is experimental. Current reference/proto mark particular values, including NEW and REPLACEMENT, rather than all schedule relationships.
limitations.why_nonmaterial: The added cases do carry experimental caveats and final still states their concrete requirements; it does not reject standard scheduled/canceled messages or downgrade their binding semantics.

limitations.description: Discovery expressly proposed full-dataset feed snapshots. Final includes missing/empty cases and correct OTP snapshot history but does not spell out a populated FULL_DATASET followed by a smaller populated snapshot, nor unsupported DIFFERENTIAL handling.
limitations.why_nonmaterial: The final rejects indefinite message retention and requires schedule-only fallback for missing updates; no contrary incremental merge algorithm is recommended. This is a specificity limit of proposed future validation, not a demonstrated erroneous consumer or missing required deployment.

consequential_source_claims.subject: GTFS static identity, calendars and ferry domain
consequential_source_claims.assessment: route_type is enum 4 for ferry; trips connect route/service IDs to stop_times. Calendar exceptions or calendar_dates-only service determine dates; no actual operator identifiers inferred.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Service date, timezone and clock semantics
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Service date differs from civil date; HH:MM:SS may exceed 24 hours. GTFS schedule stop times use agency_timezone and noon-minus-12h DST semantics. Proposed date/DST checks apply to actual feed, not server date.

consequential_source_claims.subject: RT feed header and schedule revision
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Header generation timestamp is uint64 POSIX seconds; optional string feed_version matches static feed_info.feed_version. Namespace or URL does not prove revision equality. Suppression and owner fallback are explicitly local choices.

consequential_source_claims.subject: TripDescriptor instance conditions
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Frequency requires trip/date/start time; late overlapping instances require date; absent trip_id requires route/direction/date/time and unique resolution. Unknown-trip stop IDs and absolute event times are further reference conditions not itemized in final; its as-required/valid-message policy does not assert an incompatible acceptance rule.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Stop identity and repeated calls
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Stop ID or sequence resolves the call; repeated stop requires sequence in the proposed matching rule. NEW/REPLACEMENT require both; unidentified trips require stop IDs and absolute times. No ETA from ambiguous matching.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Message families and no-update meaning
consequential_source_claims.assessment: TripUpdates, Alerts and VehiclePositions remain distinct; missing TripUpdate means no prediction, not on-time. Canceled updates are tested separately from notices; trip modifications are named without unproved partner support.

consequential_source_claims.subject: NEW, REPLACEMENT, DUPLICATED and NO_DATA
consequential_source_claims.assessment: NEW is unrelated non-static trip; REPLACEMENT uses a named static instance and full replacement stops/times. Required stop IDs/sequences/arrival/departure and past-stop retention are resolved; NO_DATA preserves supplied schedule without prediction. DUPLICATED differs from NEW; legacy ADDED requires version-aware migration. Experimental status belongs to individual values, not the entire enum.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Timing units/types and propagation evidence note
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Delay is signed seconds; event/scheduled_time are absolute POSIX seconds. Candidate source-map S05 wrongly equates all missing stop updates with unknown: prior delays can propagate until another update/NO_DATA. Final does not prescribe that false universal omission rule; see L2.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Freshness recommendations versus SLA
consequential_source_claims.assessment: 30 seconds refresh, 90 seconds TripUpdates/VehiclePositions, and 10 minutes Alerts are best-practice recommendations. Header/fetch success is distinct from record age. Local age cutoff and wording require owners; unrun tests exercise stale header and embedded event.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Alert applicability and temporal domain
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Fields inside a selector intersect; separate selectors independently apply. Alert active_period governs display, not departure prediction. Current communication_period/impact_period are distinct added fields, not claimed as deployed; missing TimeRange rule is bounded to documented alert display.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Full snapshot disappearance
consequential_source_claims.assessment: FULL_DATASET replaces preceding state; DIFFERENTIAL remains unspecified. Discovery proposes a full-dataset snapshot check; final tests missing/empty data and preserves OTP cleanup history, but does not name a successive-partial-snapshot assertion. No final keep-until-next-trip-message rule survives.

consequential_source_claims.subject: OTP release and backend fit
consequential_source_claims.assessment: v2.10.0 is released 2026-09-09 at 521cd5d8acaae628878f43bf5946f4942c118548. Purpose is multimodal APIs; separate board is an inference supported by actual architecture, not turnkey deployment evidence.

consequential_source_claims.subject: OTP namespace/configuration defaults
consequential_source_claims.assessment: feedId is graph-build dataset namespace; build-config precedes nonstandard feed_id then numeric fallback. HTTP TU/Alert/VP frequency is duration PT1M; fuzzy matching boolean false. Backwards default required-no-data and forwards default are separately conditioned. No feed-version protection inferred.

consequential_source_claims.subject: OTP positions failure/fix and timestamp operation
consequential_source_claims.assessment: PR #6523 merged 2025-03-14, listed v2.8.0 2025-09-10. Code replaces per-feed prior positions using immutable copy. ISO lastUpdate is recorded vehicle time, not poll-success time; no TU/Alert expiry or revision guard is derived.

consequential_source_claims.subject: OTP static version GraphQL field
consequential_source_claims.assessment: PR #7445 and v2.10.0 expose static version through nullable Feed.version: String, resolved by FeedImpl.version(). Final calls it feedVersion; capability and static-vs-RT distinction are correct but exact field locator is wrong. No executable query or product test claimed.

consequential_source_claims.subject: OneBusAway alternative and version applicability
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Moving README documents sign-mode and separately configured TU/VP/Alert sources. Latest release v2.7.1 commit 095bf1a is independently verified. Main docs are not silently declared identical to release; ferry/stale/editor compatibility remain unknown.

consequential_source_claims.subject: TransXChange/SIRI analogue and conditions
consequential_source_claims.assessment: DfT bus profile combines TxC schedule with subscribed SIRI-VM, shared IDs, UTC recorded/validity fields and producer/heartbeat cadence; ID changes can require revised timetable. OTP ET/SX supports Nordic/EPIP subsets with required feedId/PT1M. Profile-specific analogue is not ferry support or dispatch.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Released feed-version history and anecdotes
consequential_source_claims.assessment: Issue #362 winter timetable mismatch leads to #434 optional field, merged 2024-12-05. Discussion explains different publication/activation times; Swiss/TransSee details are attributed participant reports, not audited deployments.

consequential_source_claims.subject: Optional editorial advisory and owner authority
consequential_source_claims.assessment: The original brief authorizes an option, not existing backend capability. Final keeps separate editorial label/times/review/expiry, proposes expanded triggers for manager decision, and retains all named owners/exclusions. No unjustified exclusion or mandatory promotion.
